hooks.name: Review Changed Files on Stop
hooks.description: After an agent execution completes, reviews the files that were just modified for TypeScript errors and accessibility issues, and reports problems without automatically changing unrelated files.

action.prompt:
A code-modifying agent execution just finished. Perform a focused review of ONLY the files that were changed in this session.

Scope rules (strict):
- Determine the set of changed files first. Prefer `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` to identify them. Review only those files.
- Do NOT edit, format, or "fix" any files as part of this review. Do NOT modify unrelated files. This is a read-and-report task only.

Checks to perform on each changed file:
1. TypeScript errors — run `npx tsc --noEmit` and attribute any reported errors that originate in the changed files. Also run `npm run lint` and report type/lint issues tied to the changed files.
2. Accessibility issues in changed .tsx components, per this project's standards:
   - Every section is clearly labelled (headings / aria-labels / landmarks).
   - Interactive elements are keyboard accessible and have accessible names.
   - Images use `next/image` with meaningful `alt` text.
   - Colour contrast and focus states are adequate.
   - Semantic HTML is used over generic divs where appropriate.

Reporting:
- Produce a concise report grouped by file, then by category (TypeScript, Accessibility).
- For each problem, give the file, line (if known), a short description, and a suggested fix — but do NOT apply the fix.
- If no problems are found in a category, say so explicitly.
- If there were no changed files to review, state that and stop.
